name: r7-ends-meet-full
description: ⛓ THE HEADLINE of chain "toy-west-pair" — the same walk in ONE run, so the 2 segments have something to be tick-for-tick IDENTICAL to. Inputs are `transition-west-return`'s, unchanged since R1, truncated at the second ARRIVAL (t=109) so that the LAST segment also ends at one. `pins: ["dead_frames"]` makes `save.time` update-determined (it counts dead frames, which are per-RENDER in vanilla); `rng.fp` is declared because FlashPunk seeds its LCG once per PAGE from `Math.random()` and a committed chain cannot inherit a random number.
